snippet.title: FPP Gun Tryout | Ultimate Weapon Guide | Ringnet Scoop
snippet.description:
Every weapon has its moment—just match it with the map and your tactics.
Pick right, aim well, win big.
I'm Lighty, and today I’ll show you how to go from empty-handed to final fight MVP!

ABOUT FARLIGHT 84

In Farlight 84, you get to play as heroes with unique skills to outsmart your enemies, unleashing special abilities to catch them off guard... AND you get to collect adorable Buddies to join you as loyal companions in battle. Buddy up, it’s time to Battle Royale!
